The previously recorded odd-characteristic three-point formula has disjoint field hypotheses and does not imply the present all-order binary-field result.

value.rationale: The all-order exact Chowla-type correlation reduces a natural family of arithmetic statistics to the rational critical points of the shift polynomial, yielding a uniform positivity/divisibility phenomenon and an exact four-shift zero/nonzero classification. It is not merely a reparameterized known bound: the general large-field theory does not identify these integer correlations and the result spans arbitrary k and infinitely many binary fields. Its explicit derivative geometry suggests meaningful comparisons to other degrees and even extensions without claiming them.
